---
title: CLI Reference
---

The SearcherKit command-line interface is used to run configurations, evaluate outputs, inspect configurations, and manage plugins.

## `searcherkit run`

Run a SearcherKit configuration.

```bash
searcherkit run
searcherkit run --config-path recipe/webexplorer --config-name webexplorer
```

Additional arguments are passed as Hydra-style overrides:

```bash
searcherkit run \
  --config-path recipe/webexplorer \
  --config-name webexplorer \
  agent.llm_client.model=demo
```

## `searcherkit evaluate`

Evaluate saved run records using an LLM judge.

```bash
searcherkit evaluate outputs/webexplorer outputs/webexplorer_eval \
  --max-concurrency 32
```

The evaluation process uses the `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variables.

## `searcherkit inspect`

Recursively validate configuration fields against their corresponding structured config types without running the agent.

```bash
searcherkit inspect \
  --config-path webexplorer \
  --config-name webexplorer
```

- Raise **ERROR** when unexpected field in config (not in target dataclass) or required field missing (no default value in target dataclass)

Hydra-style overrides are also supported:

```bash
searcherkit inspect \
  --config-path websailor \
  --config-name websailor \
  agent.llm_client.model=demo
```

## `searcherkit plugins`

List plugins or run plugin deployment tools.

```bash
searcherkit plugins list
```

Deploy a local Wiki index:

```bash
searcherkit plugins deploy local-wiki \
  --wiki_dump_path data/wiki.xml.bz2 \
  --es_host http://127.0.0.1:9200 \
  --index_name wiki_local \
  --overwrite
```

Deploy BrowseComp Plus:

```bash
searcherkit plugins deploy browsecomp-plus \
  --dataset_path data/browsecomp_plus_corpus.jsonl \
  --es_host http://127.0.0.1:9200 \
  --index_name browsecomp_plus \
  --overwrite
```

Add `--dense-vector --model_name Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B --embedding_dim 1024`
to enable dense-vector indexing.
